title: •Sergeant Doallyn
caption: •Sergeant Doallyn (V)
game_text: Heroic. Smuggler. When deployed, may play a Defensive Shield (and/or deploy a Vibro-Ax on him for free) from under your Starting Effect (as if from hand). When using a Vibro-Ax, it fires for free. Immune to attrition < 4.
lore: Humanoid mercenary. Gambler. Blackmailed into working for Jabba. Friend of Yarna d’al’ Gargan. Expert in breathing apparatus. Needs Hydron 3 cartridges to breathe.

notes: Group: Everything Else (LIGHT SIDE). Unique. Bottom-half slip. Stats POWER 3 / ABILITY 3 / FORCE-ATTUNED (label only) — printed: POWER 3 / ABILITY 2 / empty third box; deploy 3 / forfeit 4 (as printed). Icon column: warrior (blue, blaster) only. No inline icons; no credits. Affiliation Alien (Jabba's Palace alien frame, eyes disc). Lore: curly apostrophes in d’al’ (the wiki has straight ones; the 350 px scan shows comma-shaped marks — Decipher's usual curly assumed); 'Gambler.' looks plain on the 350 px scan (not marked bold — low-res, not inferred). Otherwise matches the wiki. Base scan JP-L-sergeantdoallyn.gif 350 px only; copyright not legible — Jabba's Palace 1998 line by rule. Modern: VB4-L-sergeantdoallyn-pre.gif (350, Virtual Block 4 reissue; its text is a later revision: 'Vibro-Ax is a matching weapon for (and deploys for free on) Doallyn…'). Slip text matches the stub.
